claim_summaries.claim: The Beenakker fixed branch p1=p2=1 and ancilla z=0 is an exact CNOT with amplitude 1/(2 sqrt(2)) and input-independent success probability 1/8.

For the named PBS charge-one detector, the interleaved branch U^dagger P1(a)P1(b)U is the same-spin projector on the one-per-arm basis, while terminal P1 after undoing the PBS is identity on that input subspace.
A rational site-local spin rotation of a two-site opposite-spin singlet generates nonzero up-up and down-down terms, so this source family is not closed under arbitrary site-local spin rotations.
No conversion of the sequential Beenakker branch to one terminal hard projection and a rational opposite-spin pair matrix F is established; no general no-go is established either.

next_gate: Construct an explicit terminal-projection teleportation gadget over the exact opposite-spin F interface, or prove a named impossibility under explicit restrictions.
